title: Git Rebase Strategy for Feature Branches
summary: Use interactive rebase to clean up commits before merging. Squash WIP commits and write meaningful commit messages.
content:
## Workflow
1. Create feature branch from main
2. Make commits freely during development
3. Before PR: `git rebase -i main`
4. Squash WIP commits, keep meaningful ones
5. Write conventional commit messages

## Rules
- Never rebase shared branches
- Always force-push with lease: `git push --force-with-lease`
- Keep PR commits atomic and reviewable

## Benefit
Clean git history makes debugging with `git bisect` much more effective.

title: TypeScript Strict Mode Migration Strategy
summary: Migrate to strict TypeScript incrementally: start with strictNullChecks, then noImplicitAny, finally full strict mode.
content:
## Strategy
1. Enable `strictNullChecks` first (catches most bugs)
2. Fix all null/undefined errors
3. Enable `noImplicitAny`
4. Add explicit types to all function parameters
5. Enable full `strict` mode

## Tips
- Use `// @ts-expect-error` temporarily for complex cases
- Create a `strict-migration.md` to track progress
- Fix one module at a time

## Result
Reduced runtime errors by 60% after full strict mode migration.

title: Docker Multi-Stage Build Optimization
summary: Use multi-stage Docker builds to reduce image size. Separate build dependencies from runtime dependencies.
content:
## Before
Single-stage Dockerfile: 1.2GB image

## After
Multi-stage build: 180MB image

```dockerfile
# Build stage
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Production stage
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Impact
- 85% reduction in image size
- 3x faster deployment
- Reduced attack surface

title: Monorepo Dependency Management with pnpm
summary: Use pnpm workspaces for monorepo management. Configure shared dependencies at root and package-specific ones locally.
content:
## Structure
```
root/
  pnpm-workspace.yaml
  packages/
    shared/     # Shared utilities
    ui/         # Component library
    app/        # Main application
```

## Key Config
```yaml
# pnpm-workspace.yaml
packages:
  - 'packages/*'
```

## Best Practices
- Pin shared dependency versions at root
- Use `workspace:*` protocol for internal packages
- Configure `.npmrc` with `shamefully-hoist=true` for compatibility
- Run scripts with `pnpm -r run build` for all packages

## Benefit
Reduced `node_modules` size by 45% compared to npm workspaces.

title: Error Boundary Pattern for React Applications
summary: Implement granular error boundaries to prevent full-page crashes. Use different boundaries for different UI sections.
content:
## Strategy
Don't wrap the entire app in one error boundary. Use granular boundaries:

```tsx
<AppErrorBoundary>           {/* Catches catastrophic errors */}
  <Layout>
    <Sidebar />               {/* Own boundary */}
    <SectionErrorBoundary>    {/* Catches page-level errors */}
      <Outlet />
    </SectionErrorBoundary>
  </Layout>
</AppErrorBoundary>
```

## Key Insight
When a chart component crashes, only the chart section shows an error state. The rest of the app remains functional.

## Recovery
Provide a 'Retry' button in error fallback UI that resets the error boundary state.
